persona.summary: Founder-led 18-staff turner (<2 M EUR, equity 19.6 %), looking for new customers with its second shift idle; our ~EUR 59k is ~3 %+ of its turnover and it calls us a reference customer. Shares the spacer sleeve 50/50 with sup:70295 (4.64 vs 4.60) and is qualified for the coupling hub. In P05 it dropped 38.5 -> ~30.5 at once and agreed ~29.3-29.5 in round 2 (only 1 of 7 sessions closed). Open deep, trade 14-day payment and volume, cite rival prices.
persona.notes: Needs work and reliable cash; fears losing spacer share to sup:70295. Its overdue-invoice complaint is justified: we pay 10 days late on average, 75 % of invoices >5 days late. Quality is green (VDA A) but OTD slid 95.8 -> 88 %. Arena: an agreed deal broke when we kept negotiating.
fears: losing spacer sleeve share to sup:70295

delivery-record argument ('does not change our calculation')
promising faster payment we cannot keep
tactics: Open deep; its first counter is a big step regardless.
Pair 14-day payment with a binding volume in one package; it squeezes its calculation for that.
Cite the rival price; it checks it and moves after 'clarifying internally'.
When it agrees, close immediately; do not add or change a term.
playbook.expected_concession: Fast: in P05 first counter ~20 % below its opening, agreed in round 2 at ~24 % below; renewals settled 1.3 pts below its ask.
